scope: Closed arithmetic-demo sublanguage, NOT complete TC0-A catalog
source_map_coordinates: Unsigned decimal strings; no coordinate interpretation qualified yet

frames.step: Store ONE value; enter next operand or set Ready; never execute operation in this step
Extend immutable environment and enter body
Choose ONE branch using Bool and restore saved environment

dispatch_rules.step: Push Collect frame and enter first operand; metadata is not evaluated
Push Let frame and enter initializer
Push If frame and enter condition

ready_rules.step: Produce exact typed Value or begin Unwind with Overflow/DivZero
Invoke, application Emit, Commit(Unit), then produce Unit; no continuation consumed

root_rules: Value/Unwind with empty continuation enters implicit root Join
Join exits root scope (no child tasks supported) and propagates saved outcome
Next Run emits root termination and disables all decisions
Unwind discards exactly one ordinary frame per Run, without executing code
unsupported: Calls, closures, tuples, datatypes, Bytes and all B/C tags are rejected by this demo validator; rejection is not full TC0-A conformance
review_obligations: Root entry/exit and trap diagnostic identities
Every remaining A frame including true tail calls and closure capture_support=[]
Independent catalog/fixture review before authority promotion
